name: Ibara Hime
source:
Ririko and Suzuki were sister and brother separated by one year. 
Like twins in their understanding and love, the grew up the best of friends. 
Time changed them, however, and while they still attended school 
as classmates, and shared the same home, they rarely spent time together. 

Rikiko now had her first boyfriend. 
She hoped to repair her delicate relationship with Suzuki, but... 

Incest / school / melancholy game.
There is not a happy ending for the protagonist. 
There is forbidden love between siblings. 

Explore the routes of Thorn Princess if your heart can bear it. 
Unwilling affairs. Bloodshed. Depression. Sickness. Death. No salvation. 
These are the themes. Please be warned. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117030.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
莉莉子与瑞树是一对相差一岁的姐弟。
小时候，他们像双胞胎一样理解、爱护彼此，也是最好的朋友。
然而，时间改变了他们。虽然依旧是同年级的同学，住在同一个家里，两人却很少再共度时光。

如今，莉莉子交了第一个男朋友。
她希望修复与瑞树之间微妙的关系，可是…

一款以乱伦、校园与忧郁为题材的游戏。
主人公不会迎来幸福的结局。
故事中存在姐弟之间的禁忌之恋。

如果你的心能够承受，就来探索《荆棘公主》的各条路线吧。
不情愿的情事、流血、抑郁、疾病、死亡，没有救赎。
这些就是本作的主题。请务必留意。

［摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE117030.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
